CYP2C19*2.sentence: Genotypes containing CYP2C19*2 (i.e., CYP2C19 *1/*2, *2/*17, *2/*2, *2/*3) are associated with increased risk of composite cardiovascular events within 6 months when treated with clopidogrel in people with acute ischemic stroke as compared to extensive-metabolizer genotypes without loss-of-function alleles (CYP2C19 *1/*1, *1/*17, *17/*17; P = .048).
CYP2C19*2.explanation: In the prospective multicenter PLATELET trial of 2,910 Korean patients with acute ischemic stroke on clopidogrel, carriers of loss-of-function alleles (including CYP2C19*2) had higher 6‑month composite cardiovascular events versus noncarriers (2.7% vs 1.6%; log-rank P = .048).

CYP2C19*3.sentence: Genotypes containing CYP2C19*3 (i.e., CYP2C19 *1/*3, *3/*17, *2/*3, *3/*3) are associated with increased risk of composite cardiovascular events within 6 months when treated with clopidogrel in people with acute ischemic stroke as compared to extensive-metabolizer genotypes without loss-of-function alleles (CYP2C19 *1/*1, *1/*17, *17/*17; P = .048).
CYP2C19*3.explanation: The same PLATELET trial grouped CYP2C19*3 carriers as loss-of-function; these carriers showed a significantly higher rate of 6‑month composite cardiovascular events on clopidogrel versus noncarriers (log-rank P = .048).

CYP2C19*17.sentence: Genotypes CYP2C19 *1/*17 and *17/*17 (carrying CYP2C19*17 without a loss-of-function allele) are associated with decreased risk of composite cardiovascular events within 6 months when treated with clopidogrel in people with acute ischemic stroke as compared to genotypes carrying loss-of-function alleles (CYP2C19 *1/*2, *1/*3, *2/*2, *2/*3, *3/*3, *2/*17, *3/*17; P = .048).
CYP2C19*17.explanation: In PLATELET, noncarriers of loss-of-function (which include CYP2C19*17-containing extensive metabolizer genotypes) had lower 6‑month composite cardiovascular events on clopidogrel than carriers (1.6% vs 2.7%; P = .048).

CYP2C19*1.sentence: Genotypes CYP2C19 *1/*1 and *1/*17 are associated with decreased risk of composite cardiovascular events within 6 months when treated with clopidogrel in people with acute ischemic stroke as compared to genotypes carrying loss-of-function alleles (CYP2C19 *1/*2, *1/*3, *2/*2, *2/*3, *3/*3, *2/*17, *3/*17; P = .048).
CYP2C19*1.explanation: The trial defined CYP2C19 *1/*1 and *1/*17 as extensive metabolizers (noncarriers of loss-of-function) and observed significantly fewer 6‑month composite cardiovascular events on clopidogrel versus loss-of-function carriers (P = .048).
